properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1205.002 (Socket Filters). Adversaries may attach filters to a network socket to monitor then activate backdoors used for persistence or command and control. With elevated permissions, adversaries can use features such as the `
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1205" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-023
